name: saved-replies-create-permission-member
description: part 2 of 2 - the restricted member can use Saved Replies but not create them
resolvedBy: claude-in-chrome walk of app.salesmessage.com, as the admin (Google SSO) and as the member
outro: Thanks for watching | Questions? Reach out any time - we are happy to help
warnings:
Demo Demo's 'Can create Saved Replies' must be OFF (part 1 leaves it that way) - otherwise Create is
enabled and the take records the opposite of the story.
profile-member/ must hold the member session (signed in by hand once).
Rebuilt from video-qa 2026-10-17: line holds sized from measured TTS length; narration waits for loaded content (picker list, settings list), not for the empty shell.
